existing_tools.observability: src/web-observability.js emits closed aggregate-only v2 events; Free/BYOK completed events sampled every twentieth process-local success; other outcomes full. KV uses 15-minute buckets, TTL 7200 seconds, 50ms observer budget. Raw counts cannot directly yield unbiased failure rates or exact latency p95.
